defaultPrompt: Preview these photos as an Instagram carousel.
Save this announcement as a draft with different versions for LinkedIn and X.
Show my scheduled TikTok and YouTube posts for next week.
release_notes: Adds platform-specific connection links during AI onboarding. Users can authorize a chosen social platform directly after any required SimplePost sign-in, then return to their AI conversation to verify the connection and prepare a draft. Connection links check that the browser and AI use the same SimplePost account. Includes clearer posting-failure recovery and exact trial expiry dates; expired trials retain read-only access to saved posts, calendar and accounts.
commerce_description: The plugin does not support purchases or direct subscriptions. Hosted publishing requires an existing active SimplePost trial or paid plan; no purchase or checkout is performed through the plugin.
